svg.title: Urgent and mine, plus two states with no box
svg.desc: The Eisenhower matrix with important swapped for mine. Mine and urgent goes to my next actions, where the matrix says Do. Mine and not urgent goes to my later list, where it says Schedule. Work that isn't mine becomes a proposed handoff whether it is urgent or not, including where the matrix says Delete. Outside the grid, already settled items become recorded decisions, and items that aren't clear yet go to needs review.
